preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have control of the ________ address (0x3aB960dCf9359083DC126222c03bfB0d2A3C9b6b)
Attacker must hold some MemeFarm tokens to sell

exploit_hint: As the owner or controller of the ________ address, call qwidji() to blacklist the attacker's address, preventing token sales. Then manipulate tax settings via setAllTaxes() to set sell taxes to 100%, making selling impossible for regular users while the attacker can still sell tax-free using setlsExcIudeFromFee(). This creates a honeypot where users can buy but not sell, allowing the attacker to profit from token purchases.
